review:
A 6x4 rock-and-roll avalanche game. Winning symbols explode, and Avasplit randomly grows some of the leftovers by one size. Locked Enhancer Cells sit under the middle four reels.

Regular wilds and xNudge wilds can land anywhere, with xNudge wilds sliding up or down into view, and xWays and xSplit pile on more ways. High volatility, 20,066x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
